stakeDefaults.comment: Default production minimum: 2 HBAR (2 * 1e8 = 2e8 tinybar). Dev override: 0.1 HBAR (1e7 tinybar). See composition/w6-stake-gate.mjs. v3: currency is Hedera tinybar, not ETH/wei.

stakeFormulaReference.notes: L-ECONOMICS-FORMULA v3 (L-ECONOMICS-DYNAMIC-STAKE): currency is Hedera tinybar (1 HBAR = 1e8 tinybar). Each profile's stakeRequirementPolicy is consumed by resolveGateForProfile via buildStakeGateFromPolicy(). The combined formula is requiredStake = max(theoreticalFloor, rollingEarnings * slashingRatePerDay, requiredStakeTheory(price, cost, audit, slash, pBeat)). Providers set their own inferencePriceBaseUnits; the gate scales with both the price and recent rolling earnings. New providers (no earnings) get the theoretical floor (~2 HBAR) only. See docs/handoffs/w6-v3-economics-formula.md.

profiles.pinReason: The hosted application contract is fixed; the verifier lane has not yet produced its final profile SHA-256/reference-bank pin, so audits fail closed.

stakeRequirementPolicy.notes: DEMO v3: 1-tinybar inference price with sponsor-covered cost. grossMargin = 1 - 0 = 1 tinybar (positive, but tiny). Theoretical floor of 2 HBAR (2e8 tinybar) dominates because the floor is the minimum. New provider → 0 earnings → theoretical floor only. Stake = max(2 HBAR, 0, ~tiny) = 2 HBAR. The legacy flat 0.1 HBAR dev minimum (stakeRequirement=1e7) is the env-var override path used during DEMO.

profiles.pinReason: The sealed verifier profile is pinned, but the hosted application's 27B profile digest has not yet been supplied by the serving adapter, so quote admission fails closed.

stakeRequirementPolicy.notes: PRODUCTION v3: 1 HBAR (1e8 tinybar) per inference, 0.5 HBAR (5e7 tinybar) cost → gross margin 5e7 tinybar = 0.5 HBAR. Theoretical floor ~2 HBAR dominates for new provider. With 100 HBAR/day rolling earnings, the earnings floor (10 HBAR = 1e9 tinybar) dominates for busy providers. Stake = max(2 HBAR, rollingEarnings * 0.10, theoreticalFloor).
